originality.rationale: Novel assessed statement is the labelled maximal induced matching polynomial and exceptional cyclic purity. The maximum induced matching size in products and structural projection are known from Brešar et al. (arXiv:2406.04020), credited; global maximal-match counts from Yuan et al. (arXiv:2410.11288) do not imply this distribution. Extensive alias searches and full-text comparisons show no direct covering theorem, subject to implicit-derivation and unindexed-source risks.
residual_risks: The lexicographic projection proof of arXiv:2406.04020 may implicitly contain a route to the dissociation-support correspondence; the new maximality and enumeration consequences must be assessed for independent priority.
Unindexed specialized well-indumatched or maximal-induced-matching generating-function literature may contain equivalent cyclic coefficients.
The older DIMACS 2004-26 full report was not inspected; only its public abstract was compared.

value.rationale: Every cardinality coefficient of inclusion-maximal induced matchings in a natural infinite strong/lexicographic-product family is obtained, including nontrivial lower facet-size floor/ceiling spectrum and nonmonotone exceptional purity n=3,5. These are independent of knowing the maximum induced-matching number. The general weighted dominating-dissociation bijection is an exact structural enumeration principle.
